phase: Pre-implementation research baseline; implementation validation is recorded in docs/experimental/context-results/plan.json
recommendation: Retain captured results independently of their model views. Prefer useful initial views and exact readback, use bounded code for exhaustive computations, and use ranked retrieval for discovery. Preserve existing context-frame stability and durable operation state.

sources.title: The Complexity Trap
sources.finding: Observation masking was competitive with summarization in SWE-agent software engineering evaluations. The paper also evaluates a hybrid and reports summarization overhead and longer trajectories.
sources.qualification: Results depend on scaffold-specific window tuning; they do not establish one policy for every domain or provider.

sources.title: Recursive Language Models
sources.finding: External programmatic access to long inputs can improve long-context tasks, including inputs beyond the root model's context window.
sources.qualification: Recursive model calls add cost and latency variability; the authors identify guardrails and natural-task evaluations as open work. The local probe evaluates deterministic code only.

sources.title: Lessons from building Claude Code: Prompt caching is everything
sources.finding: Prompt caching depends on stable prefixes. Tool changes and history rewrites affect suffix reuse; cache-safe compaction reuses the parent request prefix.
sources.qualification: The local cache tests use an emulator, not provider billing measurements.

sources.title: Writing effective tools for AI agents
sources.finding: Tools should return relevant information and may expose concise/detailed views. Response formats and tool design require task-based evaluation.
sources.qualification: A compact result still needs identifiers, errors and evidence required for the next action.

sources.title: Code Mode: give agents an entire API in 1,000 tokens
sources.finding: Cloudflare combines progressive API discovery with code execution inside isolated workers and explicit outbound capabilities.
sources.qualification: TurenOS's current in-process interpreter is not equivalent to a V8 worker isolation boundary.

sources.title: Context Mode benchmark
sources.finding: Documents strong byte reductions on fixed tool-output fixtures and exact chunk retrieval examples.
sources.qualification: These fixture byte ratios do not establish TurenOS task completion, billed token costs or generated-program accuracy.

contextBenchmark.qualification: Every variant produced identical metrics within each scenario in this run, so this run does not demonstrate comparative savings.

cachePressure.qualification: Both emulated providers recorded one cold start and one prune-associated prefix break over 28 requests; this is not an A/B comparison or actual provider billing.

implementationOrder: Retain structured results and captured text independently from the size of the initial model view; include provenance, capture-loss and expiration metadata.
Add scoped exact readback and useful deterministic views, preserving permissions and durable execution settlement.
Add bounded CodeMode access for exhaustive filtering and aggregation with explicit host capabilities.
Add ranked result search for discovery, with clear coverage and a path to exhaustive inspection.
Evaluate live model-generated programs and query selection on representative tasks before changing default compaction or routing policies.
